# ==============================================================================
# Rule #18 Wrapper Trigger (Stage plugs oe_rule_is_world_concert_off here)
# global_var:oe_v120_rule_override: 0/unset = Standard, 1 = Standard, 2 = Concert Only, 3 = Off.
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. Rule #18 Off gate (follows Game Rule #18 unless overridden by Dev Page 88 global_var:oe_v120_rule_override).
oe_con_rule_is_off = {
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 3
		AND = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 1 }
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 2 }
			oe_rule_is_world_concert_off = yes
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Eurasian Concert Founding & Eligibility Triggers
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. Historical/dynamic window to found oe_io_eurasian_concert (1700+, or 1648+ under high hegemon tension).
oe_con_can_found_concert = {
	NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
	NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
	OR = {
		current_year >= 1700
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1648
			OR = {
				oe_heg2_tension_high = yes
				any_great_power = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					is_subject = no
					oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Valid independent realm to sit in the Eurasian Concert.
oe_con_is_eligible_concert_member = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	country_type = location
	num_locations >= 10
}

# Country scope. Holds a Pentarchy Seat in the Eurasian Concert.
oe_con_has_pentarchy_seat = {
	exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
		country_has_special_status = {
			type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
			country = prev
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Valid target for the Anti-Hegemonic Containment Pact.
oe_con_is_hegemon_containment_target = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	num_locations > 0
	OR = {
		oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes
		oe_heg2_has_any_tier2_plus = yes
		is_hegemon = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. At least one valid hegemon target exists for Anti-Hegemon Containment.
oe_con_any_hegemon_target_exists = {
	any_great_power = {
		oe_con_is_hegemon_containment_target = yes
	}
}

# Location scope. Eligible Roman World frontier location adjacent to existing Roman Oikoumene jurisdiction.
oe_con_is_valid_roman_frontier_loc = {
	is_land = yes
	is_passable = yes
	has_owner = yes
	exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
	NOT = { is_owned_by_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
	is_neighbor_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
	owner ?= {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
	}
	OR = {
		region = region:balkan_region
		region = region:anatolia_region
		region = region:italy_region
		region = region:crescent_region
		region = region:caucasus_region
		area = area:levant_area
		area = area:crimea_area
	}
}

# Country scope (Middle Kingdom leader). Holds at least one non-China-proper tributary/subject or an existing Grand Protectorate.
oe_con_mk_has_overseas_or_duhu_subject = {
	OR = {
		any_subject = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
			}
		}
		any_subject = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			capital ?= {
				NOT = { region = region:north_china_region }
				NOT = { region = region:east_china_region }
				NOT = { region = region:south_china_region }
				NOT = { region = region:west_china_region }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				any_international_organization_member = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
					capital ?= {
						NOT = { region = region:north_china_region }
						NOT = { region = region:east_china_region }
						NOT = { region = region:south_china_region }
						NOT = { region = region:west_china_region }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Epidemic/quarantine trigger for International Maritime Sanitary Accord.
oe_con_sanitary_accord_available = {
	OR = {
		current_year >= 1650
		has_global_variable = oe_con_sanitary_unlock
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				any_international_organization_member = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						oe_dis_country_infected_any = yes
						oe_dis_has_any_lazaretto = yes
						oe_dis_has_pestkordon = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Controls one of the four major Eurasian maritime chokepoints.
oe_con_controls_major_strait = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:hormuz
		owns = location:malacca
		owns = location:constantinople
		owns = location:gibraltar
	}
}
